    • submitBorrowRequestForDates

      public static int submitBorrowRequestForDates(String listingId, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Submits a borrow request from calendar dates. Each date is combined with the current time of day, then checked by submitBorrowRequest(String, LocalDateTime, LocalDateTime).
      Parameters:
      listingId - lend listing
      start - first day
      end - last day
      Returns:
      the request id
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a date is missing or the resulting period is rejected
      SecurityException - if the current user is not an active buyer

    • submitBorrowRequest

      public static int submitBorrowRequest(String listingId, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Submits a borrow request for an exact start and end time. The length must be at least DatabaseManager.MIN_BORROW_SECONDS and at most the seller's lending period.
      Parameters:
      listingId - lend listing
      start - borrow start
      end - borrow end
      Returns:
      the request id
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the listing is not a lend listing, the buyer owns it, or the requested length is outside the allowed range
      SecurityException - if the current user is not an active buyer

    • getAllDeals

      public static List<DataService.DealRecord> getAllDeals(String search, ListingType type, String status)
      Read-only system-wide accepted deals, including completed/returned history; requires an active admin. Null type/status disables that filter. Search is a case-insensitive literal title/username match. Start date is borrow_start when present, otherwise request creation; complete date is the actual return/completion timestamp. Scheduled return is exposed separately for borrowed items.
